India advises citizens to postpone travel to Iran amid rising instability

The Indian government has advised its citizens to postpone non-essential travel to Iran due to the country's increasing instability. The advisory applies to both Indians already in Iran and those planning to visit. The move comes as tensions between Iran and other countries escalate. The government is urging citizens to exercise caution when traveling abroad.
